newsitem.title: USA: Clinton formally sworn in for second term.
newsitem.headline: Clinton formally sworn in for second term.

text.p: President Bill Clinton was formally sworn in for a second four-year term on Monday in the traditional inaugural ceremony on Capitol Hill.

He repeated an oath, prescribed by the U.S. Constitution and administered by William Rehnquist, chief justice of the U.S. Supreme Court: "I, William Jefferson Clinton, do solemnly swear that I will faithfully execute the office of president of the United States, and will, to the best of my ability, preserve, protect and defend the Constitution of the United States." Like presidents since George Washington in the 18th century, Clinton added, "so help me God."
